selection.name: A55 cluster comparator
selection.scope: Recompile the frozen OPE5-02 FP16-storage/FP32-accumulate GEMV semantics for Cortex-A55, pin four workers to CPU0-3, and measure the same M=1,K=10240,N=2560 complete matrix. Reuse the closed A76 receipt as the only primary anchor; do not rerun A76.

alternative_primary_disposition.OPE3_int8_GEMV: Not selected because changing both cluster and dtype/ISA would weaken the first A55 comparison; retain as separate context only.
alternative_primary_disposition.OPE5_03_RMSNorm: Not selected because its single-thread population has much smaller stage relevance and a different topology from the four-core cluster question.

A_authenticity.evidence: The semantic shape, 42-call frequency, FP16/FP32 contract, row-major layout, four-way partition, and full-matrix working set are inherited exactly from the frozen and valid OPE5-02 primary. CPU0 is the first core captured by the board identity and exposes fphp/asimdhp; existing telemetry records policy0 at 1.8 GHz.
A_authenticity.limit: A55 placement is deliberately synthetic comparator placement. It is not an assertion that the closed W8A8 RKLLM carrier dispatches this GEMV to A55 or to CPU at all.

B_bottleneck.evidence: OPE5-02 supplies a valid four-A76 FP16 primary for the exact same semantics. One four-A55 row quantifies practical big.LITTLE sensitivity without changing dtype, logical shape, thread count, partition, oracle, or working set.
B_bottleneck.limit: The comparison does not identify the OPE4 NPU/runtime decode gap. Raw latency combines clock, microarchitecture, cache hierarchy, memory service, compiler target, and synchronization effects.

C_capability.evidence: The captured first-core feature set contains asimd, fphp, and asimdhp, which is sufficient for the frozen FP16-load/FP32-FMA implementation. The board exposes policy0 at 1,800,000 kHz and the existing taskset/governor/telemetry/perf harness supports an isolated four-core lane.
C_capability.limit: Before source-lock, a read-only topology gate must reassert policy0 related_cpus=0-3, all four requested affinities, 1.8 GHz max, and the required feature bits. The A55 binary must be newly compiled with -mcpu=cortex-a55; the A76 binary is not reused.

D_deliverability.evidence: The result can add one explicitly labelled A55 row beside the immutable OPE5-02 A76 primary and report raw p50 ratio, analytic-GB/s ratio, and cycles-per-invocation ratio. Within-A55 scalar/autovec/NEON results retain the three-baseline method.
D_deliverability.limit: No deployment-speed, hardware-leaderboard, OPE4 component-attribution, quality, energy, or cost claim is deliverable. Cross-microarchitecture L2D/bus event ratios remain descriptive unless event semantics are independently established.

reasons: It is the immediately preceding valid A76 primary required by READY_COMPARATOR_AFTER_PRIMARY_A76_ITEM.
Both clusters have four cores, so thread count and 640-row partitioning remain identical.
The first-core board feature evidence already covers the FP16 conversion/FMA instruction requirements.
The 52.4 MB full-matrix traversal reduces cache-resident proxy ambiguity and keeps the comparator bounded.
primary_choice_rationale.a76_anchor_strength: Single owner-waived formal segment; reuse is immutable and nonconcurrent, so environmental pairing is not claimed.

analytic_account.interpretation: The OPE0 denominator was measured on four A76 cores and is retained only as the project-wide shared platform ceiling. It is not an A55-specific bandwidth ceiling or a frequency-normalized causal model.

a55_design_identity.output_partition: Four fixed contiguous N/4=640-row partitions, one per pinned A55 worker.
prelock_assertions: required FP16/ASIMD feature bits are present
all named perf events are available numerically in a compile/probe-only capability check that does not execute the benchmark

novel_evidence_contract.new_measurement: Four-A55 FP16-storage/FP32-accumulate GEMV for the exact valid OPE5-02 semantics and full 52.4 MB matrix.
novel_evidence_contract.primary_comparison: A55 neon_fp16_f32acc p50 divided by immutable OPE5-02 A76 neon_fp16_f32acc p50, co-reported with the 2.352/1.8 GHz max-frequency ratio and PMU cycles-per-invocation ratio.
secondary_comparisons: Within-A55 candidate speedup versus A55 autovec and scalar baselines.
A55 analytic GB/s divided by immutable A76 analytic GB/s.
A55 instructions and IPC reported descriptively; L2D refill and bus_access remain lineage-local unless event semantics are proven equivalent.
duplicate_avoidance: Do not rerun OPE5-02 on A76.
Do not rerun OPE3 int8 GEMV or OPE5-03 RMSNorm.
Do not add A76/A55 mixed scheduling, one-core scaling, gate/up, prefill, NPU, RKLLM, model, quality, energy, or thermal-stress lanes.
Do not treat OPE0 as an A55-specific bandwidth calibration.

decision.next_action: Freeze configs/operator/board/ope5_a55_fp16_gemv_prereg.json and verify both scope and preregistration before implementation.
decision.no_automatic_fallback: If topology or perf capability conflicts with the frozen design, repair the explicit preregistration before implementation; do not silently switch to int8, RMSNorm, fewer cores, or an A76 rerun.

claim_limits: A55 is a comparator lane, not the primary OPE4 CPU lane and not evidence of closed-runtime placement.
The A55/A76 wall-time ratio is a system-level cluster comparison, not a single-variable microarchitecture causal estimate.
The A76 anchor is reused from one owner-waived formal segment and is not concurrently paired with the future A55 segment.
No board connection, candidate implementation, benchmark execution, A76 retest, NPU/RKLLM run, or quality evaluation occurs in this scope stage.
